verdict.rationale: Proa ships routing as part of the framework itself. Routes are registered in `src/routes.rs` between generator-maintained markers, inspected with `proa site routes`, and can carry route-spec options such as page caching. Every render also gets typed access to route state through WebContext, and the docs describe going 'Axum-native for Proa routing and responses'. missing for 10: documentation of route parameters, nested layouts and client-side navigation, evidence of a standalone routing package beyond the built-in route table, independent hands-on corroboration.
